commands.spookydoors.not_door: Block at %s is not a supported door.
commands.spookydoors.set_forced: Door spooky state set to %s. FORCED config currently ignores this state.
spookydoors.configuration.title: Spooky Doors
spookydoors.configuration.spookyDoorActi: Controls which doors Spooky Doors affects. OPTIONAL requires doors to be toggled on with the command, DEFAULT affects doors unless toggled off, and FORCED affects all doors.
spookydoors.configuration.allowItemToExo: Allows players to use items in the spookydoors:exorcises_doors tag on spooky doors to make them non-spooky. By default, this is honeycomb. This has no effect when Spooky Door Activation is FORCED.
spookydoors.configuration.allowItemToHau: Allows players to use items in the spookydoors:haunts_doors tag on non-spooky doors to make them spooky. By default, this is a ghast tear. This has no effect when Spooky Door Activation is FORCED.
spookydoors.configuration.moveCameraWith: Turns the player's camera while dragging a spooky door open or closed, to avoid immersion-breaking hard stops.
